findings.question: Q5
findings.defect: A maritime EEZ, airports and mineral reserves are obviously unrelated to irrigation command areas; answer can be guessed without content knowledge.
proposed_distractors: Increase the gross storage capacity of existing reservoirs without improving field distribution
Replace canal irrigation with exclusively rainfed cultivation
Expand irrigation potential on paper without field channels or on-farm water management
findings.verification: Proposals are editorial candidates only; official command-area programme definitions and unambiguous option-level checks required before insertion.

findings.question: Q6
findings.defect: Only motorcycles, local footpaths and None are implausible alternatives to railways for high-volume long-distance bulk freight.
proposed_distractors: Road haulage using heavy trucks on long-haul corridors
Coastal shipping for suitable port-connected bulk routes
Inland waterways on navigable river systems
findings.verification: Question stem must be narrowed to inland, land-based bulk freight or rewritten as a context-dependent choice: coastal shipping and waterways can also efficiently carry bulk freight, so proposed alternatives cannot simply be treated as categorically wrong.
